reviews.title: Excellent upgrade for the price
reviews.comment: Excellent ram sticks for the price. They do not overheat with my cooling system, easy to install, and do not over draw power. When installing, they appeared to be durable, and is a significant memory upgrade. They are true to their specs, I personally have it set to 2666 mphs, but they can reach 3200.
reviews.author: Sidney L.
